description: Conzerv power and energy meters with RS485 Modbus RTU: per-phase power, power factor and energy (EM1200, EM1220), current, voltage and frequency (EM1220), setup, diagnostics and identity
source: Schneider Electric Conzerv EM1000/EM1200/EM1220 power and energy meter user manual EAV95462-01, chapter 6

sources.title: Conzerv EM1000/EM1200/EM1220 Power and Energy Meters - User Manual

notes: Only the EM1200 and EM1220 have the RS485 port; the EM1000 has a pulse output and no Modbus. The file keeps its old name.
Function 03 to read, 16 to write. Defaults: unit ID 1, 19200 bit/s, even parity, 1 stop bit.

Addresses are the manual's absolute addresses (3049 is 43049), so this map is 1-based. Every reading is 32 bits in two registers; floats have the word order that Modscan calls swapped (low word first).
No scaling: the meter sends the full value. The manual does not give the units of power and energy.
Power, power factor and energy readings return 0 unless the parameter is selected in the setup (Wh/VAh selection). Current, voltage and frequency are only on the EM1220.
The factory TURBO block (2501-2599) holds the same readings at other addresses and can be reconfigured; it is not listed.
The setup block (1001-1040) can only be read and written as a whole block, so its registers are read-only in this map.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
